_comment: Baseline for the SMC decision path. The SMC Lab strategy is READ-ONLY: the agent layer built around it observes the strategy and must never alter it. If a test pointing at this file fails, a decision-path file was edited or the strategy now behaves differently -- do not regenerate this baseline to make the test pass unless the change was deliberate and the new behaviour was reviewed.

revisions.reason: Strategy Intelligence merged onto the production line. live_visual_state() now also attaches an observe-only active_evidence_input to the source_strategy result after the existing decision, and flags it if the engine state changed during the decision. It does not re-evaluate, mutate the engine or change any decision; the behaviour fingerprint is identical.
